evidence.note: Dark folding camp chair is fully collapsed and stored upright in the wall corner.
Chair fabric and frame fill the view during the unfolding manipulation.
The chair is visibly deployed with its seat, back, arms, and legs open.
Chair remains deployed immediately before the closing action.
Chair is again fully collapsed and stored in the corner.

evidence.note: Blue folding camp chair is collapsed in the corner beside the bright window.
Chair fabric fills the foreground during the unfolding action.
Blue chair is visibly deployed on its legs with the seat and back open.
Chair is still deployed but partly blurred during the start of the closing manipulation.
Chair is fully collapsed and returned to the window-side corner.

events.object_description: Blue folding camp chair in the corner beside the window and desk

notes: Two distinct folding-chair interaction episodes are visible. Camera survey and repositioning between these episodes were not counted as interactions.
